newsitem.title: USA: ABC/Money consumer comfort index -3 Jan 19 week.
newsitem.headline: ABC/Money consumer comfort index -3 Jan 19 week.

text.p: The Money Magazine/ABC News said its consumer comfort index jumped four points to -3.0 in the week ended January 19.

The random survey, this time with 1,041 respondents, polls consumers nationwide about the national economy, their own finances and their willingness to spend money. The poll has a margin of error of plus/minus 3.5 percent.
Respondents' confidence in the economy fell to -4.0 from -2.0 the previous week.
But confidence in personal finances jumped to 20 from 18 and Americans' rating of buying climate rose four points to -26.

Confidence gained in all major regions of the nation, the report said. The Northeast advanced the most, gaining five points to -3. The Midwest rose to -3 from -7, the West advanced three points to -1 and the South rose to -5 from -7.
